reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model SE4570, which is a recalled model. Per the claim policy, the label photo confirms the model even though the typed model 5E4570 is a typo.

No destruction photo is required for this remedy, and no other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial, or payout account with this one.
